notes.title: Devlog
notes.content:
[h1]Hey! It's been a while since our last post, so here we are! [/h1]

[h2]Sign up for upcoming playtest on our game's page![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1473180/This_is_Timmy/


[h2]Current state of the game:[/h2]
The game is fully playable, right now we are working on levels and preparing everything for final playtest. 

[h3]What we have so far:[/h3]

[b]Updated main menu, we tried many variants of menu and this one sticks to our hearts the most! [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/c299574ffd539edab7de3665a553b83b6537791d.png[/img]


[b]Added level selector UI[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/5dfbfe15ecd90b612ec4c107e04dc0e4b44833b9.png[/img]


[b]Added feature of selecting face color and added ingame inventory of unlocked hats for you Timmy![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/429f87a9188d94fad38b2f4906f6e2eb5797bd42.png[/img]


[b]Added multiplayer UI, now you can host public or private game for 2, 3 and 4 players![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/9db63e27f1546aeb217510d94dd140427f4b6090.png[/img]


[b]Added level selector for multiplayer lobby, now Host can select levels based on amount of players in a lobby! [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/f3c3b49f83d711833873efc59eff5afdd640c4ed.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/04c3f14362d722e68753cbff0c2e4fd3be984ff8.png[/img]


[b]Added ping ability for multiplayer, players can choose one of four different pings, such as "warning", "look here", "go here" and countdown ping[/b]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/sDqKpcpJryZVra3hxs/giphy-downsized-large.gif[/img]


[b]Added subtitles for voice lines in test chamber + Added tutorial hints![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/dbc8cb5cb405283d6608d07653795dab9f1d45f7.png[/img]

Thank you for reading this post! Follow for more and don't forget to wishlist This is Timmy on steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1473180/This_is_Timmy/

notes.title: News blog
notes.content:
[h1] What's new? [/h1]
We are preparing for new playtest, with the help of social medias, a lot of cool players have appeared in our community, thank you all for your help and feedback!

[list]
[*] The plot is completely finished and now we are working on cutscenes and story levels
[*] All popular bugs have been fixed, thanks to all the participants of our wonderful discord server for their help! (the bug with the button is here, let it be a feature, you really liked it!)
[*] Added skins! Now you can paint your Timmy in 16 new colors! And choose a cute hat for him
[*] MULTIPLAYER! Finally! It is still in development, everything works smoothly, there are a couple of bugs, but we will fix them soon, there will be multiplayer in the beta test!
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

[h3][b]Dont forget to wishlist the game![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1473180/This_is_Timmy/

notes.title: Demo update 0.333
notes.content:
[h1]Update v.0.333 is live now! [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41041526/21774f0bf2a6fee3365c83557bec857ef7efff2b.png[/img]
Some small hot-fixes, tweaks, and new bugs already! How exciting!

Changes-list:
-Fixed kill zones
-Added audio reverbs
-Added cubekiller
-Added new checkpoint on level 3
-Tweaks in level geometry
-Added sound effect for wooden box on first cutscene
-Minor changes


Let us know in [url=https://discord.gg/Ay8kHQHFkH]our discord [/url]what you think about new rocket launcher!
Have fun, gamers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1473180/This_is_Timmy/
